name: Automotive
description: This hub covers the gear that keeps a vehicle running, connected, and presentable: car electronics and GPS units, automotive parts and touch-up supplies, and driving accessories. It's for anyone comparing options before a purchase, whether that's a jump starter for winter mornings, a paint pen for a scratch, or a mount for a phone. Guides here focus on practical decision points: which features actually matter for daily driving, what's worth paying more for, and where cheaper options hold up fine. Coverage is uneven across subcategories right now, so start with the featured picks below if you're not sure where to begin.

name: Electronics
description: Headphones, projectors, and everyday electronics, weighed on performance, build quality, and true real-world price.

name: Home Appliances
description: Kitchen tools, vacuums, and household equipment, evaluated for reliability, longevity, and true day-to-day value.

name: Health and Fitness
description: Wellness and fitness gear, matched to different routines, recovery requirements, and realistic everyday budgets.

name: Lawn and Garden
description: Smart robotic mowers, electric corded tools, and automated garden helpers tested across yard sizes and slopes.
